body:
Plan, rules and numbers: wf-context/docs-gaps/pass2.md (read "How a section is bound" first). Worktree wf-docs2, branch docs/pass2; DOCS_COMMON.md applies. Per-section list: wf-context/docs-gaps/pass2/out-before/binding-sections.md.

Rules in short: bind claims, not mentions. For each target section, cite the code its claims depend on: `pass2/dsdef.sh <file>#<Symbol> [stable|api]` prints the id (idempotent, writes `//ds:def` in this repo's style), then link the name in the sentence: [`Name`](ds:block?id=<id>). Defaults and limits cite their const. Pitfalls that state library or driver behaviour cite the code (or the test) that makes it true. Snippet-synced Go blocks stay with `task docs:snippets`; bind the prose around them. Only `//ds:def` lines may change in library files. Never run `ds scan`, `ds ack` or `ds refresh` (the coordinator scans and commits `.ds/` once at the end); `ds check` must stay at 0 errors.

Owns: `docs/workflows/`; examples: chain-edits, escalation, escalation-wrappers, first-workflow, flow-boundary, flow-cancel, flow-children, flow-joins, flow-memo, flow-patterns, flow-promises, flow-replay, flow-stages, machine-dsl, saga-choreography, signals-and-sleep, state-machine, then-redo, virtual-objects, workflow-json.

Binding now: 22 pages, 180 sections describe library code (Try it and Related excluded), 0 bound.

## Bind (one line per page: target sections, bound now, the unbound ones)

- [ ] `docs/workflows/branching.md` (5 target, 0 bound): (top); Before you start; Build a choice; Errors; Pitfalls
- [ ] `docs/workflows/chains.md` (7 target, 0 bound): Before you start; Step 1: enqueue a job with a chain; Step 2: edit the chain from a running step; When a run fails; Hatchet: use child runs; Chains, steps and batches; Pitfalls
- [ ] `docs/workflows/children.md` (5 target, 0 bound): (top); Before you start; Start children with Spawn; Wait for children with AwaitChildren; Pitfalls
- [ ] `docs/workflows/definitions-as-data.md` (19 target, 0 bound): (top); Before you start; Write the definition; Register the handlers; Load and register; Refusals name the place; Store and edit a definition; Reload without a deploy; YAML; State machines as data; Write the machine; Register the guards and actions; Load and register the machine; Edit a definition in Go and build it; Timers; Refusals and storage; JSON reference; Machine JSON reference; Pitfalls
- [ ] `docs/workflows/escalation.md` (10 target, 0 bound): Before you start; Signal one run by its ID; Escalate from a child to its parent; Handle signals between steps; Bind the client in a plugin; Approvals, races and updates by run ID; Behind wrappers; Which drivers; Prove it on your driver; Pitfalls
- [ ] `docs/workflows/groups-and-guards.md` (8 target, 0 bound): Before you start; Set up the client; Step groups; End a run early; Limit recursion; Catch changed steps under running runs; Typed from enqueue to result; Pitfalls
- [ ] `docs/workflows/joins.md` (10 target, 0 bound): (top); Before you start; Continue on the first child to succeed; Continue on N of M; Decide what happens to the rest; Add children while waiting; Cancel every child of a step; Run downstream work once per arriving branch; Run a child per item of a large source; Pitfalls
- [ ] `docs/workflows/memoisation.md` (11 target, 0 bound): (top); Before you start; Turn on the journal; Memoise a call with Memo; Run a call per item with MapEach; Loop until done with Loop; Process rows in chunks with progress; Share a value across steps; Share data across runs; Write your own journal store; Pitfalls
- [ ] `docs/workflows/multi-choice-and-race.md` (8 target, 0 bound): (top); Before you start; Multi-choice; Merge only the branches that ran; Race: the first answer wins; A default branch at a deadline; Wait for all of, any of, or a mix; Pitfalls
- [ ] `docs/workflows/objects.md` (8 target, 0 bound): Before you start; Define an object; Call it; Read the state; How a call is applied once; Find a key's calls; A method the object does not have; Pitfalls
- [ ] `docs/workflows/partitions.md` (6 target, 0 bound): Before you start; Start one run per partition; Run a backfill again safely; Read the status of every partition; Retry only the failed partitions; Pitfalls
- [ ] `docs/workflows/polling-and-approval.md` (6 target, 0 bound): (top); Before you start; Poll until a condition holds; Sleep until a time; Human approval; Pitfalls
- [ ] `docs/workflows/promises.md` (7 target, 0 bound): Before you start; Wait for a promise; Ask a run and get its answer; Start a run if it is not running, then signal it; Loop for ever as a chain of runs; Withdraw several steps of a run; Pitfalls
- [ ] `docs/workflows/replay.md` (9 target, 0 bound): Before you start; Write the code as one function; How a replayed handler runs; The calls; Errors; Keep the code deterministic; Deploy changed code; Pitfalls; Replay, memoisation or steps
- [ ] `docs/workflows/sagas.md` (5 target, 0 bound): (top); Before you start; Do, then abort; Across steps; Pitfalls
- [ ] `docs/workflows/signals.md` (7 target, 0 bound): (top); Before you start; Wait for an event; Match the event to the run; Give up after a deadline; Deliver only to runs waiting now; Pitfalls

- [ ] `docs/workflows/state-machines.md` (17 target, 0 bound): Before you start; Data, guards and actions; States; Transitions and guards; The order actions run in; Compound and parallel states and done events; History; Timers; Define the machine; Start an instance and send it events; Unhandled events; Read an instance and its log; Delete an instance; Guarantees; Drivers and storage; A machine, workflow steps or an object?; Pitfalls
- [ ] `docs/workflows/steps.md` (7 target, 0 bound): Define a workflow; Typed handlers with Define; Steps that depend on other steps; What a step knows about its run; Timeouts; Run a handler when a run fails; Pitfalls
- [ ] `docs/workflows/then.md` (6 target, 0 bound): (top); Before you start; Start a workflow when another finishes; Redo runs; Errors; Pitfalls
- [ ] `docs/workflows/trigger-rules.md` (8 target, 0 bound): (top); Before you start; Tolerate a step, route its failure, always clean up; Send a missed deadline to a fallback; Setup and teardown; The rules; A timer that does not stop the step; Pitfalls

## Gaps to close

- [ ] multi-choice-and-race.md, Merge only the branches that ran: the synced snippet never names `MultiChoice`, so the feature row counts as a mention; widen the region (flow-patterns) so the step shows the `MultiChoice` call it merges.
- [ ] If a page states one of these values, cite the const instead of typing the number: `DefaultMapInFlight`, `DefaultMapKeepFailed` (MapEach), `GroupSeparator`, `StepKind` (`StepRun`, `StepWait`) in definitions-as-data.

## Done when

- [ ] `python3 tools/binding.py` + `tools/batches.py` (see pass2.md) show every target section of this batch bound, or the report names the section and why it states no claim worth binding.
- [ ] `ds check` 0 errors; `task docs:wrap docs:links docs:snippets docs:words` pass; `go test -race` of every example touched.
- [ ] Report wf-context/reports/docs-p2-w1.md with before/after binding counts, defs added (id, file), Shared-file lines, Library bugs, DONE.

binding.py + batches.py: every target section bound
ds check 0 errors on W1 pages; docs:wrap links snippets words pass; example tests
